formal_with_id.description: Standard formal requirement with explicit ID and 'shall' verb
formal_with_id.input: REQ-BHT-1: The BHT shall implement BHTDepth entries and index them using the lower bits of VPC_i. The width of VPC_i shall match CVA6Cfg.VLEN.

output.text: The BHT shall implement BHTDepth entries and index them using the lower bits of VPC_i. The width of VPC_i shall match CVA6Cfg.VLEN.

formal_no_id.description: Formal requirement without explicit ID (still has 'shall')
formal_no_id.input: Each BHT entry shall contain a two-bit saturating counter that encodes the prediction state and shall saturate at its limits.

output.text: Each BHT entry shall contain a two-bit saturating counter that encodes the prediction state and shall saturate at its limits.
output.note: ID will be auto-generated as REQ-4.1.5.4.1-002

conditional.description: Conditional requirement with 'when' clause and 'shall' in consequent
conditional.input: When reset is asserted, all BHT counters shall return to the weakly-not-taken state (2'b01).

output.text: All BHT counters shall return to the weakly-not-taken state (2'b01)

table_based.description: Requirement extracted from table row (e.g., signal direction constraint)
table_based.input: Table Row: bht_prediction_o | out | Prediction from bht | FRONT END | ariane_pkg::bht_prediction_t

output.text: The bht_prediction_o signal shall be an output directed to the FRONT END with type ariane_pkg::bht_prediction_t
output.citation_snippet: bht_prediction_o | out | Prediction from bht | FRONT END | ariane_pkg::bht_prediction_t

physical_constraint.input: The BHT depth (BHTDepth) shall be configurable and must be a power of 2.
